meta.dataset: Atlantic hurricane database (HURDAT2) 1851-2025, best-track records for AL092017 (Harvey) and AL092008 (Ike) only
meta.units: lat/lon in decimal degrees (north and east positive); vmaxKt = maximum 1-minute sustained wind in knots; pressureMb in millibars; r34/r50/r64 and rmwNm in nautical miles
meta.notes: Extracted unchanged by research/scripts/build_best_tracks.py. r34/r50/r64 are the HURDAT2 'wind radii maximum extent' in the NE, SE, SW and NW quadrants. A radius of 0 means that wind speed is not reached in that quadrant; null means missing in the source (-999; -99 for wind). rmwNm (radius of maximum wind) is routinely best tracked only from 2021, so it is null for almost every fix here. recordId 'L' marks a landfall fix; other fixes have ''. Fixes are 6-hourly plus asynoptic landfall records. The file covers each system's whole life, including the wave, low and extratropical stages (see 'status').
